name: logi-vhid-mcp
description: Windows x64 local desktop input and coordinate queries through Logitech virtual HID.
long_description: Six local stdio MCP tools for status, desktop coordinates, mouse, keyboard, text and stop. Input is disabled by default. Enabling input only grants capability: the host must obtain approval for each operation. Requires a compatible Logitech G HUB virtual HID bus for HID input; no driver or G HUB installer is bundled. Screenshots, remote HTTP and OAuth are not provided. Desktop-wide input is not isolated to a window, and submission is not application acknowledgement. Host compatibility and hardware acceptance must be verified separately.

allow_input.title: Allow keyboard and mouse input
allow_input.description: Disabled by default. Enable only when you explicitly want this service to accept input requests. The host must still approve each exact target, action and value; this setting never enables automatic approval.
